adjudication.rationale: In `app/assets/javascripts/admin/components/embeddable-host.js.es6`, the `delete()` action calls `this.get('host').destroyRecord().then(() => { this.sendAction('deleteHost', this.get('host')); });` with no `.catch(...)`. If the DELETE request fails (e.g., 403/404/race), there is no error handling or user feedback (unlike `save()`, which uses `catch(popupAjaxError)`), so the failure is effectively silent and the UI does not reflect the error state.
